 Order

The petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 along with the accused No.1 have been charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 109 read with Section 34 of IPC.
2.
The summary of the charge sheet is that, the defacto complainant is the legally wedded wife of the accused No.1.
The accused No.2 is the mother-in-law.
The accused No.3 is the sister-in-law.
The accused Nos.4 and 5 are the brothers-in-law.
The accused subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty both physically and mentally.

3. On 20.5.2022, the accused No.1 picked up a quarrel and asked her to leave the matrimonial home along with the child and he would contract the second marriage, and the other accused instigated the accused No.1 to assault the defacto complainant.
4. The learned Magistrate, after accepting the charge sheet, took the cognizance for the aforesaid offences.
5. Though the respondent No.2 has been served with notice, she has not chosen to appear in person or through her counsel.
6. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 and the learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State.

Perusal of the charge sheet material indicates that there is no specific allegation as against the accused Nos.2 to 5, as to how, and in what manner, they subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty, both mentally and physically, except the general and omnibus allegations.
The last of the event had taken place on 20.5.2022 and the FIR was lodged on 6.11.2022 without offering any plausible explanation.

8. The Hon'ble Apex Court in Kahkashan Kausar v. State of Bihar, (2022) 6 SCC 599 has held that the relatives of the husband should not be roped in on the basis of omnibus allegations unless specific instances of their involvement in the crime are made out.

entities.text: State of A.P. v. M. Madhusudhan Rao [(2008) 15 SCC 582]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Time and again, the object and importance of prompt lodging of the first information report has been highlighted.
Delay in lodging the first information report, more often than not, results in embellishment and exaggeration, which is a creature of an afterthought.

A delayed report not only gets bereft of the advantage of spontaneity, the danger of the introduction of a coloured version, an exaggerated account of the incident or a concocted story as a result of deliberations and consultations, also creeps in, casting a serious doubt on its veracity.

Therefore, it is essential that the delay in lodging the report should be satisfactorily explained."
NC: 2023:KHC-K:1122 10.
The charge sheet laid only on the basis of omnibus and general allegations in the absence of specific allegation is without any substance.
Hence, the continuation of criminal proceedings will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
ii) The impugned proceeding in CC No.1322/2023 (Crime No.114/2022 of Kalaburagi Women Police Station) pending on the file of the learned I Addl.
Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Gulbarga, insofar as it relates to petitioners - accused Nos.2 to 5 is hereby quashed.
iii) The learned Magistrate to proceed against the accused No.1 in accordance with law without being influenced by any observation made in this order.
